definitions.explanation: The location where one works, including offices, factories, stores, and other work environments.

examples.japanese: {職場|しょくば}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}はとてもいいです。
examples.english: The atmosphere at my workplace is very good.

examples.japanese: {職場|しょくば}で{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}に{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm troubled by interpersonal relationships at work.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{職場|しょくば}に{慣|な}れるまで{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to get used to my new workplace.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{職場|しょくば}の{環境|かんきょう} (work environment)
・{職場|しょくば}の{同僚|どうりょう} (coworkers)
・{職場|しょくば}に{通|かよ}う (to commute to work)
・{職場|しょくば}を{変|か}える (to change jobs/workplace)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{仕事場|しごとば} - similar but often implies a physical space where work is done (studio, workshop)
・{勤務先|きんむさき} - formal term for one's place of employment
・{会社|かいしゃ} - company (more specific to corporate employment)

[Register: Neutral]
